site.desc: A rock-cut cemetery lies beside the Romanesque hermitage near Peciña in La Rioja. The archaeological complex preserves traces of a medieval settlement and burials cut into the exposed stone, allowing the church and its surrounding funerary landscape to be explored together.

new_sites.tags: Spain Santa María de la Piscina Ageless Rock Bernie Ong

site.desc: Anthropomorphic graves cut into rock surround the remains of a medieval chapel above the Mao river in Parada de Sil. Excavations connect the cemetery with rural communities of the early Middle Ages. The surviving cuts preserve the shapes and arrangement of individual burials.

new_sites.tags: Spain San Vítor de Barxacova Necropolis Ageless Rock Bernie Ong

site.desc: About seventy rock-cut graves survive among the vineyards of San Vicente de la Sonsierra. Remains of a hermitage and rock-cut wine presses place the cemetery within a wider worked landscape. The precise location of the settlement associated with these burials remains uncertain.

new_sites.tags: Spain San Andrés Necropolis (Sonsierra) Ageless Rock Bernie Ong

site.desc: An extensive early medieval cemetery occupies the sandstone outcrop around the church of San Adrián Mártir. Roughly a hundred graves are documented, with further burials likely beneath later church alterations and access steps. This is the village church necropolis, distinct from nearby Revenga.

new_sites.tags: Spain Regumiel de la Sierra Necropolis Ageless Rock Bernie Ong

site.desc: Rock-cut graves and the remains of a church mark a deserted medieval settlement in the forest near Quintanar de la Sierra. Excavated between 1969 and 1971, the cemetery preserves a dense arrangement of burials shaped into the exposed rock.

new_sites.tags: Spain Cuyacabras Necropolis Ageless Rock Bernie Ong

site.desc: Granite walls enclose a large Iron Age hilltop settlement above the Amblés valley. Ulaca preserves houses, quarries and distinctive rock-cut monuments, including a stepped altar and a structure interpreted as a sauna. These remains illuminate the architecture and ritual life of the Vetton communities before Roman rule.

new_sites.tags: Spain Castro de Ulaca Ageless Rock Bernie Ong
